candidate_reg_evidence: RFC-0 §4: dispositions PASS / FLAG / HOLD / HARD_VETO.
assessment: Conceptual mapping only. PASS may be interpreted as bounded ALLOW and HARD_VETO as BLOCK; HOLD corresponds broadly to suspension. FLAG has no direct equivalent in the proposed ALLOW / DENY / HOLD enum. No normative enum named AdmissionDecision was found in the examined public sources.
note: Do not treat the proposed labels as normative REG status names or as a validated cross-framework equivalence.
sources: REG public corpus: RFC-0 §4 (frozen RFCs in reg-standards-baseline/rfc/)

candidate_reg_evidence: RFC-4 references Decision Receipts and an Evidence Manifest / tamper-evident evidence mechanisms.
assessment: The presence of evidence artifacts does not establish a runtime state axis for evidence-write outcomes. The reviewed public RFCs do not establish that pending or failed writes are represented by a normative EvidenceStatus axis. NIST AI RMF uses documentation, reporting, and empirical evidence in a risk-management context; the reviewed usage does not establish an equivalent runtime execution state. The ISO/IEC 42001 comparison is based on secondary sources only.
note: OP-1 remains unresolved. Do not claim that the core already covers pending/failed evidence writes. If no authoritative normative definition is found, propose an explicit core amendment.
sources: REG public corpus: RFC-4; NIST AI RMF 1.0, NIST AI 100-1 (official PDF: https://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/ai/nist.ai.100-1.pdf)
